full_name: Leah Price | Radcliffe Institute for Advanced Study at Harvard University
title: 2006–2007 Humanities Walter Jackson Bate Fellow Harvard University
bio: Leah Price is a professor of English at Harvard University, where she teaches the eighteenth- and nineteenth-century British novel and codirects an interdisciplinary seminar on the history of the book.
